nodes.label: Reuse of Thunderbird Published OAuth Client IDs
nodes.rationale: Microsoft killed basic-auth IMAP for personal accounts in late 2024 and deprecated tenantless Azure registrations mid-2025, so reusing Mozilla Thunderbird's published public client IDs is the only OAuth path not requiring the user to register an Azure tenant. Google deprecated the device flow for desktop apps, so Gmail uses loopback OAuth on a throwaway random port. Both consent screens saying 'Mozilla Thunderbird' is expected, not a misconfiguration.

nodes.label: CalDAV Over Existing Mail Credential Strategy
nodes.rationale: One Gmail consent under Mozilla's verified Cloud project grants mail and calendar together, and auth/calendar is a 'sensitive' not 'restricted' scope, so no own Google app, no verification, no CASA. Commands speak CalDAV, not the Calendar REST API, because the REST API is disabled on Mozilla's project (every calendar/v3 call 403s accessNotConfigured) while CalDAV needs only the scope.

nodes.label: microsoft-work Provider (/organizations authority)
nodes.rationale: /common mints a working first access token but refresh fails ~1h later with AADSTS7000012 because /common accepts any account type and refresh must resolve to a specific tenant; /organizations binds the grant to the AAD tenant up front so refresh sticks. Four org-side blockers (third-party OAuth disabled, IMAP disabled, SMTP AUTH disabled, Conditional Access) are not fixable from the skill.

nodes.label: Email First-Use Data Gathering
nodes.rationale: The single most important onboarding step: budget hours not minutes, fan out subagents to read sent mail and inbox in parallel, mine the personal texture (teasable quirks, contradictions) not just the professional picture, then update MEMORY.md.

nodes.label: MEMORY.md Pointer To Email Rules
nodes.rationale: The skill's Notes & rules section is only loaded when the skill opens, not on every notification, so a pointer appended to MEMORY.md (always in context) makes standing email rules fire reliably on source=email-client notifications.
